title.purpose: Title of the panel that says where the rekordbox collection comes from.
title.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel title; also the accessible name of the offer's summary list.

howTo.purpose: Tells the user how to export the collection from rekordbox.
howTo.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, shown while no export is chosen.
howTo.approved: In rekordbox, choose File > Export Collection in xml format, then pick the file here.

noneChosen.purpose: Says no rekordbox export is chosen yet.
noneChosen.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, in place of the file path.

choose.purpose: Button that opens the picker for a rekordbox export.
choose.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, while no export is chosen.

chooseAnother.purpose: Button that picks a different export.
chooseAnother.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, once an export is chosen.

readAgain.purpose: Button that reads the chosen export again.
readAgain.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, once an export is chosen.

reading.purpose: Says an export is being read.
reading.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, status while a read job runs.

fileFilter.purpose: Name of the file type in the picker's file-type list.
fileFilter.where: The system file picker opened by Choose export (and Choose another export), file-type filter for .xml.

lastRead_one.purpose: Says when the export was last read and that it held one track.
lastRead_one.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, status line after a read ({{when}} is a date and time).

lastRead_other.purpose: Says when the export was last read and how many tracks it held.
lastRead_other.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, status line after a read ({{when}} is a date and time).

neverRead.purpose: Says the chosen export hasn't been read yet.
neverRead.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, when no read has happened and none failed.

incomplete.purpose: Warns that the export is missing tracks and says they were kept.
incomplete.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, after reading an export that doesn't hold every track it lists.

notStored_one.purpose: Warns that one track in the export couldn't be read.
notStored_one.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, after a read in which one track couldn't be stored.

notStored_other.purpose: Warns that several tracks in the export couldn't be read.
notStored_other.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, after a read in which several tracks couldn't be stored.

watch.purpose: Label of the switch that watches for new exports.
watch.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, checkbox at the bottom.

newer.purpose: Offers a newer export that was found.
newer.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, when the watch finds a newer export ({{name}} is its file name).

readNewer.purpose: Button that reads the newer export.
readNewer.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, beside the newer-export offer.

failed.notFound.purpose: Says the last read failed because the file is gone.
failed.notFound.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, after a failed read; also the send checklist's export step.

failed.cantRead.purpose: Says the last read failed because the file couldn't be opened.
failed.cantRead.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, after a failed read; also the send checklist's export step.

failed.damaged.purpose: Says the export is cut off or damaged and what to do.
failed.damaged.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, after a failed read; also the send checklist's export step.
failed.damaged.approved: The export is cut off or damaged. Export it again from rekordbox.

failed.notAnExport.purpose: Says the file isn't a rekordbox collection export.
failed.notAnExport.where: Overview screen, rekordbox collection panel, after a failed read; also the send checklist's export step.

error.notFound.purpose: Error: the export file wasn't found when starting a read.
error.notFound.where: Shown where starting a read fails because the chosen file is gone (Overview rekordbox panel, send checklist).

error.notAnExport.purpose: Error: the file isn't a rekordbox collection export.
error.notAnExport.where: Shown where starting a read fails because the file isn't an export.

error.noneChosen.purpose: Error: no rekordbox export is chosen.
error.noneChosen.where: Shown where Read again or a send starts with no export chosen.
